capabilities: , Listen for newly created markdown files and inject configured frontmatter tags.
Apply configured tags to all markdown files in the current folder.
Avoid duplicate tags when the note already contains some or all target tags.
extras: Operates locally within the vault and does not send note content or telemetry to external services.
problem: Manually tagging notes and ensuring consistent metadata across related files is time-consuming and prone to error.
summary: Automatically applies configured tags to new notes and existing files based on their folder location within the vault.
